# Collins Dictionary

> > Comprehensive English language dictionary providing definitions, pronunciations, synonyms, and translations from Collins, with integrated tools for word games like Scrabble and Wordle.

Collins Dictionary is a trusted language reference platform offering detailed word definitions, usage examples, pronunciation guides, and grammar resources. The site serves language learners, writers, and word game enthusiasts with comprehensive English dictionary content and translation services.

## Key Topics

- Collins English Dictionary
- Word definitions
- Pronunciations
- Synonyms and antonyms
- Grammar resources
- Translations
- Language learning
- Scrabble word finder
- Wordle helper
- English usage examples
- Etymology
- Word games
- Bilingual dictionaries

## Core Dictionary

- [Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english): Main Collins English Dictionary with definitions, pronunciations & synonyms
